parsed.german_signal: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
parsed.notes:
Only the candidate qualifications section supplies skill requirements; technologies mentioned solely in responsibilities are excluded.
The educational fields are treated literally as fields of education, not separate technical skill requirements. 'Abgeschlossener technischer Bildungsweg' does not explicitly require a university degree and can include vocational education.
KI-supported Workflows are mapped to workflow automation; operating KI solutions does not explicitly ask for model deployment or MLOps.
Power Automate and n8n are alternatives within the platform examples; the same ask also includes unmapped Copilot Studio.
'idealerweise' qualifies experience in regulated environments, not the preceding requirement for privacy and information-security knowledge. Security Reviews maps to the already-required cybersecurity criterion.
Unspecified Berufserfahrung supplies no seniority level; optional initial contact with MedTech is domain experience, not a junior-level signal.
